core_obligations: (1): base change the DM morphism along the given morphism from a DM stack, obtaining a DM morphism; since the target is DM, the source of this base change is DM as well, and then the characterization of DM stacks supplies the scheme and the surjective etale morphism (proof lines 4759-4769)
(2): an algebraic space, viewed as an algebraic stack, is DM, so the second assertion is the special case of the first in which the test object is an algebraic space (proof lines 4770-4772)
proof_roadmap: (1)：f DM ⇒ 基变换仍 DM；目标 Z 是 DM ⇒ 基变换后的 X ×_Y Z 也是 DM ⇒ 由 DM 的刻画存在概型 U 与满 étale 的 U → X ×_Y Z。
(2)：代数空间看作栈时是 DM，故是第一句的特例。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a DM morphism of algebraic stacks the base change along any morphism from a DM stack, or from an algebraic space, admits a scheme mapping onto it by a surjective etale morphism (author lemma at source lines 4745-4759, label lemma-DM). The proof (source lines 4761-4774) base changes the morphism, uses the permanence statements for DM-ness to conclude that the base-changed stack is DM, and applies the characterization of DM stacks through etale presentations, with the algebraic space case reduced to the first assertion (proof lines 4761-4772). The combination of base change permanence with the DM characterization is the content. H2.
